ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food chain diagram, which organism is highest on the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is "FOOD WEB", and it labels organisms such as Golden Algae, Shrimp, Reef Lobster, Sea Coral, Giant Clam, Clown Fish, Green Sea Turtle, Turtle Grass, Flat Fish, Fan Worm, and Nurse Shark. Multiple food web arrows point from the direction of other organisms to the Nurse Shark on the right, for example from near Reef Lobster, Shrimp, Sea Coral, etc. to Nurse Shark. Reasoning: In a food chain or food web, the highest-level organism is usually the apex predator, that is, the organism located at the end of the predation relationship and without a higher predator eating it. According to the arrow relationships in the figure, Nurse Shark is the top consumer receiving multiple food chain paths, so the highest one is Nurse Shark.
